quest.title: Elegance? Safety First!
quest.description: Sandrone seems to be looking for us...

talks.objective: Head to the aquarium on the lower level

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon's having a bunch of fun filling up this aquarium!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since Sandrone doesn't mind, we should definitely catch some more fishies and make this place extra beautiful!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey, you two. Come over here.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It's an underwater mobility device I've been working on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Wow, that's so kind of you, Sandrone!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It's just a simple mechanical device. I saw the way you were catching fish and, how should I put this... It seemed somewhat... unsophisticated. To be perfectly frank, I found it quite difficult to watch.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It was inefficient, unskilled, and completely and utterly inelegant.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm... sorry we subjected you to that...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: No need to apologize. Everyone has their own ways of doing things. But seeing as you plan to keep adding to the aquarium, it might be best if you use this device.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: The waters of Fontaine are home to more than just harmless, ornamental fish. There are plenty of predators who could do you some real harm. This device will not only help you fish, it'll also help you flee.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Alright. Oh, and if you're going for a swim, go now. And don't forget to tell me what you think of the device. I can always make more adjustments if you have any feedback.

choices.text: I'll be sure to use it.
